situations.headline: WAM Strategic Value (WAR) - August 2026 NTA update shows 21% discount to look-through NTA

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: WAM Strategic Value (WAR) - August 2026 NTA update shows 21% discount to look-through NTA (interest 4, risk 3)

thesis.text: WAR is a LIC-of-LICs strategy run by Wilson Asset Management that seeks to exploit persistent discounts to NTA across the Australian LIC/LIT sector, including holdings like Carlton Investments (25.5% discount) and other closed-end vehicles; its own shares trade at a c.21% discount to look-through NTA, offering a potential double discount-narrowing opportunity if sector-wide re-rating (evidenced by $1.0bn of recent secondary raisings) continues [asx:93b9a09acb2bf5a769d2ef7c5ad8814f p.2].
